2608.18578.title: Compress and Forget: bitsandbytes Quantization Amplifies Proactive Interference in LLMs
2608.18578.paper_summary: Proactive interference (PI) is a documented failure mode in large language models in which retrieval of a repeatedly overwritten value degrades as prior overwrites accumulate, mirroring a classical phenomenon in human working memory. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is now the default deployment path for open-weight models, yet its effect on this failure mode has not been tested. We evaluate three precision levels (FP16, INT8, INT4/NF4, via bitsandbytes) across three architecturally distinct instruction-tuned models (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Phi-3.5-mini-instruct), holding the retrieval task fixed. INT4 quantization significantly reduces accuracy under high interference in every model (e.g., from 81.0% to 68.3% for Qwen), confirmed by paired McNemar's tests ($p \le 2.6 \times 10^{-6}$) and a mixed-effects regression spanning all interference levels; INT8, often assumed safe, also carries a smaller but real penalty in two of three models. The effect is specific to semantically similar (word-type) distractors and reverses sign under a numeric control condition, and is mechanistically linked to a rise in same-key intrusion errors under INT4 (from 21.5% to 24.6% of trials, $p = 4.8 \times 10^{-7}$). A follow-up ablation shows the effect originates in the quantized transformer backbone rather than the output projection layer. These results suggest that bitsandbytes 4-bit quantization can impose an additional cost on applications relying on long, updatable, semantically dense contexts, even when aggregate benchmark accuracy appears largely unaffected. We release our code and tokenizer-verified vocabulary construction method at https://github.com/ShayanShahrabi/compress-and-forget
2608.18578.paper_summary_zh: 主動干擾（PI）是大型語言模型中的一種已記錄的失效模式，在這種模式中，隨著先前的覆蓋值不斷累積，對重複覆蓋值的檢索會下降，這與人類工作記憶中的一種經典現象相呼應。後訓練量化（PTQ）現在是開放權重模型的默認部署路徑，但其對這一失效模式的影響尚未經過測試。我們在三個架構上不同的指令調整模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3、Phi-3.5-mini-instruct）中，對三個精度水平（FP16、INT8、INT4/NF4，通過bitsandbytes）進行評估，並保持檢索任務不變。在每個模型中，INT4量化在高干擾下顯著降低準確性（例如，Qwen的準確率從81.0%降至68.3%），通過配對的McNemar測試證實（$p \le 2.6 \times 10^{-6}$）以及涵蓋所有干擾水平的混合效應回歸；INT8，通常被認為是安全的，在三個模型中的兩個模型中也帶來了較小但確實的懲罰。這一效應特定於語義相似（字類型）干擾項，並在數字控制條件下反轉符號，並在機制上與INT4下相同鍵入侵錯誤的增加相關（從21.5%增加到24.6%的試驗，$p = 4.8 \times 10^{-7}$）。後續的消融研究顯示，該效應源於量化的Transformer主幹，而不是輸出投影層。這些結果表明，bitsandbytes的4位量化可能會對依賴於長期、可更新、語義密集上下文的應用施加額外的成本，即使總體基準準確性似乎未受到太大影響。我們在https://github.com/ShayanShahrabi/compress-and-forget發布了我們的代碼和經過標記器驗證的詞彙構建方法。
